description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two SQL generation methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across different difficulty levels and overall. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, while the vertical axis is labeled "Execution Accuracy" with a linear scale ranging from 20 to 50 in increments of 10. The chart features grouped bars, with NatSQL represented by light blue bars and TA-SQL by dark blue bars. For each category, the NatSQL and TA-SQL bars are paired together, with values of 60.21 and 63.14 for Simple, 39.64 and 48.60 for Moderate, 32.32 and 36.11 for Challenging, and 51.35 and 56.19 for Total, respectively. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart effectively compares the execution accuracy of NatSQL and TA-SQL across various difficulty levels and overall.
